meta: Durian or coffee leaves turning yellow: you can take a photo and ask AI, but don't spray chemicals because of one answer.

muc.title: Unusual yellow leaves
muc.text: Durian or coffee leaves suddenly turn yellow. Asking AI with a photo is fine, but don't spray anything because of one answer.

muc.title: A daily farm diary
muc.text: Write down fertilizing, watering and weather in your notes, then ask AI to turn them into a diary table.

muc.title: Photograph leaves properly
muc.text: Photograph the top and underside of the leaf and the whole tree, send them with the tree's age, and ask for possible causes.

muc.title: Ask an agricultural advisor
muc.text: AI only guesses from photos, so take your diary and questions to an agricultural extension officer before buying chemicals.

muc.title: Three trees, three photos
muc.text: Photograph leaves from three different trees, ask a chatbot to compare them and suggest questions for an agricultural advisor.
